_comment: A database written by a NEWER hub than the one rendering it. The attachment type does not exist yet, and the link uses a scheme the client must refuse. Neither may cost the human the ability to answer the question underneath. Fed in through the data file rather than POST /api/ask on purpose: ask-time validation would reject both, and the case being tested is a client meeting data it has never seen.
